subject: MSA redlines + Ariba enrollment: PO field mapping and consent flow
messages:
From: Heather Morgan <heather.morgan@healthsphere.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sander Klein <sander.klein@healthsphere.com>, HealthSphere Legal <legal@healthsphere.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood MSA + Ariba onboarding questions

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday. We want to get Redwood into our Ariba vendor catalog this month. Attached is our standard Ariba onboarding form. A couple of items we need clarified before we can move to procurement:

- MSA redlines: our legal team needs to confirm whether Redwood accepts PO-based acceptance language (we typically prefer explicit acceptance in SOWs + PO terms).
- PO fields: Ariba will push a remit-to and invoice_attachment flag. We need to confirm what exact PO attributes Redwood requires to process invoices (remit-to, tax ID, purchase_subtype).
- Consent/PI flow: because we touch customer data in the integration, our security team needs a short note on data residency and masking for PII in logs.

I've attached the Ariba form —Heather

Attachments: HealthSphere_Ariba_Onboarding_Form.pdf (application/pdf)

--
Heather Morgan
Sr. Procurement Manager, HealthSphere
heather.morgan@healthsphere.com
(415) 555-0127

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Heather Morgan <heather.morgan@healthsphere.com>
Cc: Sander Klein <sander.klein@healthsphere.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Ariba onboarding questions

Hi Heather —

Great to connect — I put Marissa (contracts) and Rishi (security) on the thread so we can cover legal and evidence items in one shot. Quick plan:

1) Marissa will push a redline of our standard MSA with suggested language to accept orders via PO + order form (we typically include an explicit acceptance clause but are OK with PO-based triggers if the order form is signed).
2) For PO fields, I've attached a short spec (OrderForm_PO_Field_Spec.xlsx) that lists the minimal attributes our billing pipeline requires. Key fields: remit_to.name, remit_to.address, vendor_tax_id, PO_number, line_item_unit_price, currency_code, invoice_attachment_flag. If Ariba can map these to their payload we should be good.
3) Rishi will provide a short statement on data residency and log redaction for HealthSphere's security team.

Can you confirm whether Ariba will send a separate identity (SAML) attribute for the billing contact (email) or whether the procurement contact is the only contact provided? That affects our provisioning.

I'll follow up with the MSA redline and an internal mutual action plan by end of day.

Best,
Irene

Attachments: OrderForm_PO_Field_Spec.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Heather Morgan <heather.morgan@healthsphere.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, HealthSphere Legal <legal@healthsphere.com>
Date: 2028-03-02T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Ariba onboarding questions

Hi all —

I've reviewed HealthSphere's Ariba form and drafted a focused redline of our MSA that:
- Adds an explicit Order Form acceptance trigger: we accept the Order Form where the parties have executed the Order Form referencing the MSA, or when Redwood issues an order confirmation email with the specified PO_number and scope.
- Clarifies PO variances: small pricing discrepancies (under $250 per order) will be handled via invoice correction rather than contract amendments.
- Adds an appendix listing required PO attributes (mirrors the Excel spec Irene attached).

Two negotiation flags from our side:
1) Liability cap tied to fees in the applicable Order Form (we propose a 12-month revenue cap) — suggest we put this in the Order Form rather than the Order Form being silent.
2) E-signature flow: we prefer DocuSign for Order Forms. If HealthSphere requires Ariba-only acceptance (no DocuSign), we can accept a signed Order Form PDF uploaded to Ariba provided it contains an authorized signature block.

I'm attaching the redline (Redwood_MSA_Redline_v1.docx) and a short MutualActionPlan_HealthSphere_Ariba.md that lists steps, owners, and target dates. Please review and let me know if HealthSphere legal wants alternate wording on acceptance or cap language.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Redline_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), MutualActionPlan_HealthSphere_Ariba.md (text/markdown)

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Sander Klein <sander.klein@healthsphere.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Heather Morgan <heather.morgan@healthsphere.com>, HealthSphere Legal <legal@healthsphere.com>
Date: 2028-03-03T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Ariba onboarding questions

Marissa / Irene —

Thanks for the clear redline and MAP. HealthSphere legal reviewed and our comments are light:
- We can accept DocuSign for Order Forms; if we upload a signed PDF into Ariba we will include the signature metadata.
- Regarding the liability cap tied to 12-month fees: legal proposes a fixed cap equal to the annualized spend for the first year (we'll propose a number in our redline) — but this is negotiable during contracting.
- For provisioning: Ariba will send the billing contact email as a separate SAML attribute only if our vendor admin selects the "send_billing_contact" flag during registration. Otherwise procurement contact is the canonical contact. We'll enable send_billing_contact for Redwood.

Next steps:
1) HealthSphere legal will upload a concise redline to DocuSign for acceptance by next Tue (2028-03-07).
2) We'll kick the Ariba provisioning once Redwood confirms the PO field mapping and returns the signed Order Form workflow (DocuSign or Ariba PDF).

Please confirm whether Redwood wants Ariba to provision a secondary technical contact for webhook delivery (we typically register an integrator contact for EDI/push hooks).

Thanks — Sander

--
Sander Klein
Vendor Enablement, HealthSphere
